descriptions.upstream_detokenize: Convert token ids back to text using the model's own tokenizer. Required: model (path param), tokens (body, array of token ids). Returns the decoded text string. Inverse of upstream_tokenize — use it to inspect what a logged or cached token sequence actually says.
descriptions.upstream_lora_set: Set LoRA adapter scales on one running model. Required: model (path param), adapters (body, array of {id, scale}). Returns the applied adapter set. Scales change on the live model without a reload; call upstream_lora_adapters first to see what is loaded and at what scale.
descriptions.profiles_activate: Switch llama-swap's active profile (a named model group from the config). Required: profile (body, the profile name to activate). Activating a profile changes which models are eligible to swap in. Requires server v241+ (404 on older). Use profiles_list first to see configured profiles and which one is active.
